Please post a screen shot of your Thunderbird main window when it is "non responding"? Or isn't there any main window after you fill in the password?

To have an idea whether the culprit is in the profile ant not the app itself you may try the following: Thunderbird closed, try to start the profile manager as described in the this help article https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/profile-manager-create-and-remove-thunderbird-profiles#w_start-the-profile-manager-when-thunderbird-is-closed Create a new (test) profile, start Thunderbird in the new profile, and if it keeps responding set up an account, preferably an IMAP account if you already use IMAP.

Also, to clarify, Thunderbird has no servers, but uses the ones provided by your email provider. If there is a problem with the server, it is never with thunderbird. Maybe, if you post complete text of error messages, and screenshots of your incoming and outgoing server settings, someone here who is familiar with Spectrum may have a solution.
